how: The address of a file is baseUrl + path. Read catalog/kinds.json first, then the slice of the kind you need; this file is every slice together.

status.ok: fits what was asked, by measurement and a look at thumbnails; nobody has looked at it closely
status.raw: as generated, a step of post-processing is still owed (the issue says which)
status.redo: wrong; do not use, it is kept so that the redo can be compared

backdrop.what: A far-distance strip that repeats left to right.

background.what: Full backgrounds: visual-novel rooms and streets (16:9) and tall mobile backgrounds (9:16).

character-2d.what: A 2D character or enemy, limbs apart so that it can be cut into parts.

character-part.what: Irises, brows, lashes and beards, skin tiles, face and body marks, fabric prints.

character-ref.what: A character in an A-pose, front and back as two pictures of the same size: the input of an image-to-3D step.

creature-ref.what: A creature seen from the side and from the front, two pictures.

decal.what: A flat mark on a transparent background to lay over a surface.

detail-map.what: A grey micro-detail tile to multiply over a material.

effect.what: Effect sprites and sheets for additive blending, on black unless the entry says transparent.

face-sheet.what: Six expressions of one 2D character on a sheet; the cut faces are its cells.

foliage.what: Leaves, grass, hair cards and nets on a transparent background.

key-art.what: A wide scene in one art direction, room left for a title.

mask.what: A grey tiling mask for dirt, wear and breakup.

material.what: A tiling surface as a folder: albedo, height and, where made, a normal map (tangent space, OpenGL: green up).

prop.what: One object on a transparent background, seen from the front or the side: the input of an image-to-3D step.

scene-2d.what: Side-scroller scenes (a master picture and its layers), top-down tiles and edges, sheets of small scene pieces.

sky-part.what: A redrawn quarter of a sky panorama, to be stitched over its base.

style-target.what: What a finished game in one art direction should look like; given to an image model as the reference picture.

symbol.what: Slot-machine symbols and reel frames, five themes.

trim.what: A strip that repeats left to right: mouldings, edges, bands.

ui.what: Interface pieces and sheets of icons. A sheet that was cut lists its cells.
